descriptionChirho: Gershon (also Gershom in variant spelling), the firstborn son of Levi and ancestor of the Gershonite Levitical clan; attested 16 times in standard form and once in the variant 'Gershom' (1 Chr 6:1). English 'Gershon/Gershom', Spanish 'Gersón/Guersón', Hindi गेर्शोन/गेर्शोम, Arabic جِيرْشُونَ/جَرْشُومَ, Korean 게르손/게르순, Swahili 'Gershoni/Gershomu'. The Gershom variant is an orthographic alternation of the same Levitical patriarch, not a different individual.
